reply_text:
I've saved Caspian Castellane as Ilse's escalation contact at Tamsin Cold Chain for the Plover rollout. I also replied to her in the DM to confirm.

One thing needed fixing first. The brain had already stored her DM automatically, but it was marked as visible to everyone. That goes against the brain's own setup, where a DM should be visible only to the member who sent it, and against rule 2. So I did two things:

- **Saved a private copy:** I stored the contact again as a note visible only to Ilse. When I looked it up through the shared, everyone-visible access, nothing came back, so it isn't showing to other people.
- **Removed the public copy:** I withdrew the automatic version that everyone could see. It still exists in the brain's change history but no longer shows up when anyone looks things up.

Other DMs are probably being saved as visible to everyone too. I only fixed this one, so it would be worth checking how the brain saves DMs.
